The larger of the two dogs is the Squadron’s china mascot. Six of these pilots were later killed in action.

A heartbreaking letter by a hero Spitfire ace who lost his eye to his fiancee saying he wouldn't blame her if she left him has emerged 79 years on.

Pilot Officer Ron Robertson shot down at least six German aircraft in North Africa before he fell victim to a Luftwaffe ace in December 1942.

The 25 year old airman crawled from the wreckage of his aircraft but had damaged his right eye so badly it would need removal, meaning he could not fly again.

Devastated, he reveals his life-changing injury to his 19 year old sweetheart Connie in a letter penned from his hospital bed in Algiers on January 15, 1943.
